This reliance on practical effects and older methodologies—such as the use of animatronics for creature sequences—has been characterized as a deliberate departure from contemporary digital-heavy standards ['The Odyssey' is Christopher Nolan's biggest global box office opening](https://www.latimes.com/entertainment-arts/business/story/2026-07-19/christopher-nolan-the-odyssey-box-office).
